tests.title: Validate chatbot response for hello
tests.fullTitle: Chatbot Automation Tests Validate chatbot response for hello
tests.code:
async
// Input Box
let inputBox =
await driver.findElement(
By.id('user-input')
);
// Enter Message
await inputBox.sendKeys(
test.input
);
// Send Button
let sendButton =
await driver.findElement(
By.id('send-btn')
);
await sendButton.click();
// Wait for Response
await driver.sleep(4500);
// Get Bot Messages
let botMessages =
await driver.findElements(
By.className('bot-message')
);
// Last Message
let lastMessage =
await botMessages[
botMessages.length - 1
].getText();
console.log(
"Bot Response:",
lastMessage
);
try {
assert.ok(
lastMessage.includes(
test.expected
)
);
} catch(error) {
await takeScreenshot(
test.input
);
throw error;
}
